title: Choir Loft
what: Sixteen voices reading a line each: twelve of the built-in voices and four Spanish voices from the Voice Library. Same model, very different people.

inputs.label: Voices
inputs.value: George, Lily, Callum, Laura, Brian, Charlie, Alice, Daniel, Harry, Jessica, Bill, Matilda, Francisca, Alberto Rodríguez, Silvana, July

inputs.label: Lines
inputs.value: one line each, written for its voice (English and Spanish)

snippet:
for voice in voices:
    audio = requests.post(f"https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/{voice.id}",
        headers={"xi-api-key": KEY},
        json={"text": voice.line, "model_id": "eleven_v4"}).content
